# FlippingBook

> FlippingBook is a comprehensive digital publishing platform that converts PDFs into interactive flipbooks with advanced tools for sales, marketing, and document analytics.

FlippingBook offers both cloud-based (FlippingBook Online) and self-hosted (FlippingBook Publisher) solutions for creating, sharing, and tracking interactive digital documents. The platform serves businesses across multiple industries with features for lead generation, content protection, team collaboration, and sales optimization.

## Key Topics

- PDF-to-flipbook conversion
- Interactive documents
- Digital publishing
- Document tracking and analytics
- Lead generation
- Content protection
- HTML5 publications
- Sales tools
- Marketing automation
- Document sharing
- Team collaboration
- Mobile sales app
- SEO optimization
- Interactive PDFs
- Batch conversion

## Core Products

- [FlippingBook | Flipbook Maker for Digital Publishing](https://flippingbook.com): FlippingBook homepage showcasing PDF-to-flipbook conversion and digital publishing tools.
- [FlippingBook Online | #1 Digital Publishing Platform](https://flippingbook.com/online-publishing-service): FlippingBook Online main product page with PDF publishing, tracking, and sharing features.
- [FlippingBook Publisher: Digital Publishing Software](https://flippingbook.com/digital-publishing-software): FlippingBook Publisher for HTML5 publications and self-hosting.
- [FlippingBook Salespal | Mobile app for sales teams](https://flippingbook.com/salespal): Mobile app for sales teams with document management and tracking.
- [FlippingBook Automation | Batch PDF to HTML5 Converter](https://flippingbook.com/automation): Batch PDF-to-HTML5 conversion automation with XML integration.
